moments.text: Infrared view looking down on the sea, crosshair at centre, dark in the middle and bright toward the corners. Black boxes hide the display edges.
A small bright rectangular shape on the water, trailing a faint wake, moves in from the left toward the crosshair.
After a white flash the view zooms in on an offshore platform on legs; the sensor follows it until it slides out the bottom.
A faint light streak with a short trail rises from the bottom edge, passes just right of the crosshair and leaves at the top right. About 0.6 s.
After a flash, a close view of two platforms joined by a walkway, one with a round deck. They slide out at lower left as the sensor pans.
A faint short light dash rises up the right side of the frame, from near the bottom almost to the top, in about 1 s. Easy to miss.
After more flashes the joined platforms return, smaller, near the centre of the frame.
A very faint small light dash climbs the left part of the frame, from the bottom toward the top, over about 2 s. Easy to miss.
